label: GO after an unrewarded trial (choosing a2) / D2 after a1 reaching S2 (rare); sparse within these
explanation: Never fires at D1 or on any step whose reward input is 1. Support is almost entirely (99.9% recall/mass) GO steps after an unrewarded trial plus D2 steps after choosing a1, but only ~10% of those fire. The GO part carries 74% of mass; within it, firing concentrates when the agent is about to choose a2 (model_act==2) and the largest activations come in runs of consecutive unrewarded a2 trials (two losses in a row raise precision to 0.21-0.31 but cut recall heavily). The D2 part is weak (median ~0.15 of max), peaks on rare a1->S2 transitions after a streak of rewarded a1->S1 trials, and ramps up slowly over such streaks. Also fires on D1-fixation-error GO steps (in_rew = -1, 88% rate), and more often early in episodes. The recorded predicate uses only observed variables plus the agent own choice (dev P 0.19 R 0.70 F1 0.29 mass 0.78). The binary predicate does not capture what decides whether it fires within these contexts; that seems to depend on longer reward history / value, which I did not pin down.
